title: Software Testing Intern
description:
We are looking for a detail\-oriented and enthusiastic **Mobile Application Testing Intern** to join our team. The candidate will gain hands\-on experience testing mobile applications, identifying bugs, validating app functionality, and ensuring a smooth user experience across different devices and operating systems.

You will work closely with developers and the product team to test real\-world **iOS and Android applications** throughout the development and release process.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform functional testing of **iOS and Android mobile applications**
* Test new features and application updates before release
* Prepare and execute test cases and test scenarios
* Identify, document, and track bugs and issues
* Perform UI and usability testing
* Verify app navigation, buttons, forms, notifications, media, and other interactive elements
* Test application performance, stability, and basic compatibility
* Validate app behavior under different network conditions
* Test in\-app purchases, subscriptions, notifications, and other app\-specific features when required
* Perform exploratory testing to identify unexpected issues
* Work closely with developers to communicate and verify bug fixes
* Assist in pre\-release testing and final quality checks

**Skills We’re Looking For**

* Basic understanding of **Mobile Application Testing**
* Knowledge of software testing concepts and QA processes
* Understanding of test cases, test scenarios, bug reporting, and regression testing
* Familiarity with **iOS and Android applications**
* Good analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Ability to identify UI, functional, and usability issues
* Good communication and documentation skills
* Willingness to learn new testing tools and techniques

**Knowledge of tools such as Jira, Trello, TestFlight or similar QA/testing tools is an advantage.**

**Who Can Apply?**

* Freshers and recent graduates
* Students who have completed a course in Software Testing, QA, Computer Science, or a related field
* Candidates interested in **Mobile Application Testing and Quality Assurance**
* Candidates who are detail\-oriented, analytical, and willing to learn

**Internship \& Career Opportunity**  
6 months internship with practical training and exposure to real\-world projects.  
Based on performance, selected candidates will be offered an on\-roll position with a good salary package.

**Location**  
B39, Gandhima Nagar Road,  
Hudco Colony, Murugan Nagar,  
Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu – 641004  
Ph: 8122256106/ 8122256206

Pay: ₹8,000\.00 \- ₹10,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Flutter Developer
description:
Job Description:

**Job Description\-**

**Experience: 5\+ Years**

**Location: Remote / Later on will be Hybrid after 3\-4 months later( Hyderabad, Chennai)**  
**Employment Type: Full\-time**

**About the Role:We are seeking an experienced Flutter Developer . The ideal candidate will have deep hands\-on experience in Flutter, Dart, BloC and backend integrations, with a solid understanding of modern app architecture, state management, and clean code principles.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Application Development**

* Design, develop, test, and deploy mobile applications using Flutter and Dart
* Build reusable and modular components using GetX or BLoC state management
* Integrate with RESTful APIs and backend services (using Dio, HTTP)
* Implement Firebase services like Authentication, Firestore, and Push Notifications
* Manage application performance and optimize UI/UX for seamless user experience

**Collaboration \& Code Quality**

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams including backend, design, and QA
* Participate in code reviews, ensuring adherence to Clean Architecture and coding standards
* Use Git, GitHub, and Bitbucket for version control and CI/CD workflows

**Testing \& Deployment**

* Write unit test cases using Mockito and ensure code reliability
* Manage app releases and deployment to Google Play Store and App Store
* Use Crashlytics, JIRA, and Freshdesk for issue tracking and bug resolution

**Integration \& Maintenance**

* Integrate payment gateways (Stripe, Razorpay, PayU, PayPal)
* Handle analytics, notifications, and security integration
* Conduct periodic app performance tuning and refactoring for scalability

**Required Skills:**

* Strong proficiency in Flutter and Dart
* Experience with Kotlin or Java for Android, and Swift (basic understanding) for iOS
* Solid understanding of app architecture (MVVM, MVC, Clean Architecture)
* Proficient with state management tools GetX, Bloc, Provider
* Strong understanding of REST APIs, Firebase, and mobile design patterns
* Experience with Git, JIRA, Crashlytics, and Trello
* Knowledge of Python/Django or WordPress is a plus

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
* Strong communication, problem\-solving, and mentoring skills

**Bonus / Good\-to\-Have:**

* Experience developing consumer\-facing apps with high user engagement
* Knowledge of Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, or PWA
* Previous experience leading a small development team

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* What is your ctc and ectc?
* What is your np?
* What is your current location?

Experience:

* Flutter: 3 years (Preferred)
* Dart: 3 years (Preferred)
* BloC: 3 years (Preferred)
* Total: 5 years (Preferred)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu
